meta.review_notes: Several categories (camera, contacts, storage, health) are not mentioned in the policy. For a productivity/planner app, these are likely not applicable, but they were scored as 'unknown' per the rules.

app.name: Tiimo: To-Do List & AI Planner
app.description: A visual planning and productivity app with to-do lists, focus timers, AI-powered planning, and wellbeing tracking. Designed for individuals with ADHD and autism.

verdict.one_liner: A GDPR-compliant planner that doesn't sell your data, but uses marketing trackers and keeps your info for two years after you leave.
verdict.summary: Tiimo collects standard account info and usage data to run its planning service. It explicitly promises not to sell your data and offers solid GDPR rights. However, it uses marketing cookies from Google, YouTube, and Facebook for targeted advertising, and retains your data for up to two years after cancellation.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The marketing tracking and 2-year post-cancellation data retention are notable downsides for a productivity app. While GDPR rights and the no-selling policy are positives, users concerned about ad tracking should be aware.

red.title: Marketing cookies for targeted ads
red.plain_english: Tiimo uses cookies from Google, YouTube, and Facebook to track you across websites and show you targeted ads. This means your browsing activity on their site is being used to build an advertising profile.

red.title: Data may leave the EU
red.plain_english: Your data might be processed in countries outside the EU/EEA. Tiimo says they use legal safeguards called Standard Contractual Clauses, but your info is still moving across borders.

red.title: Keeps your data for 2 years after you quit
red.plain_english: Even after you cancel your subscription, Tiimo keeps your personal data for up to two years in case you come back. After that, they say they delete it.

red.title: Continued use counts as accepting policy changes
red.plain_english: If Tiimo updates their privacy policy, they will notify you, but just continuing to use the app means you automatically agree to the new terms. You don't have to actively re-accept.

green.title: Does not sell your data
green.plain_english: Tiimo explicitly states that they do not sell your personal data to anyone. This is a strong positive commitment.

green.title: Full GDPR rights available
green.plain_english: You can access, correct, delete, restrict, port, or object to the processing of your data. You can also withdraw consent at any time by emailing them.

green.title: Strong children's privacy protections
green.plain_english: If a child under 13 uses the app, a parent or guardian must create the account and give consent. Tiimo promises to delete any data collected from children without parental consent.

green.title: Payments handled by third parties
green.plain_english: Tiimo does not store your full payment details. All payment processing is handled securely by trusted third-party providers like the App Store and Google Play.

categories.detail: No references to contacts, address book, or phonebook access were found in the privacy policy.
concerns: Policy is silent on this category

categories.label: Storage & File Access

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Tiimo shares your data with trusted service providers like payment processors, hosting companies, and analytics services, but explicitly says it does not sell your data.
categories.detail: Data is shared with payment processors, IT/hosting providers, and analytics services. The company explicitly states it does not sell personal data. Data may be processed outside the EU/EEA with Standard Contractual Clauses.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not sell your personal data. However, we may share your data with trusted third-party providers who help us deliver and improve Tiimo.

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Tiimo collects your name, email, subscription details, and payment-related information to manage your account.
categories.detail: Standard account data is collected including name, email, subscription details, and payment data managed through third-party processors.
categories.policy_excerpt: Name, Email address, Subscription details, Payment data
concerns: Payment data collected even if handled by third parties

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Tiimo uses marketing cookies from Google, YouTube, and Facebook to track your activity and deliver targeted ads across websites.
categories.detail: The cookie policy reveals extensive marketing tracking via YouTube, Google, and Facebook cookies that track visitors across websites for targeted advertising. Statistical cookies from Microsoft Clarity and Google Analytics are also used.
categories.policy_excerpt: Marketing cookies are used to track visitors across websites. The intention is to display ads that are relevant and interesting to the individual user.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Tiimo requires a parent or guardian to create accounts for children under 13 and promises to delete data collected without proper consent.
categories.detail: The policy requires parental consent for children under 13 and commits to deleting any data collected without such consent.
categories.policy_excerpt: If a child under 13 years of age uses Tiimo, their account must be created by a parent or legal guardian... If we become aware that a child has provided personal information without a parent or guardian's consent, we will delete that information promptly.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Tiimo logs your IP address and tracks how you interact with the app and website using analytics tools.
categories.detail: IP addresses and usage data are collected automatically. Analytics services (Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics) track user interactions with the website.
categories.policy_excerpt: IP address, Usage data (e.g., how you interact with the app/website)

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Tiimo collects basic device information like your device type and operating system, and uses cookies that can help identify your browser.
categories.detail: Device type and OS are collected. Marketing and statistical cookies (including Facebook _fbp cookie and device ID cookies) contribute to browser fingerprinting.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device information (e.g., device type, operating system)

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention collecting health or biometric data. The app does track mood and wellbeing, but the policy is silent on how this data is handled.
categories.detail: The app features 'Wellbeing' tracking (mood, energy, focus), but the privacy policy does not explicitly address whether this qualifies as health data or how it is processed.
concerns: App has wellbeing features but policy doesn't address health data classification

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Payment details are handled by third-party processors like the App Store and Google Play. Tiimo does not store your full payment information.
categories.detail: Payment processing is outsourced to trusted third-party providers. The app does not store full payment details directly.
categories.policy_excerpt: We work with third-party payment processors (like App Store and Google Play) to handle your payments. We do not store your full payment details.
concerns: Some payment-related data is still collected by Tiimo

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request to delete your data, but Tiimo keeps it for up to two years after you cancel your subscription before actually removing it.
categories.detail: GDPR rights are fully listed and available. Requests are handled within one month. However, data is retained for up to two years after subscription cancellation.
categories.policy_excerpt: We keep your data for as long as you have an active subscription. After you cancel, we retain your data for up to two years in case you decide to return. After that, your data is deleted.

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Tiimo will email you or notify you in the app about significant privacy policy changes, but if you keep using the app, that counts as accepting the new terms.
categories.detail: Significant changes are communicated, but continued use constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
categories.policy_excerpt: If we make significant changes, we'll notify you by email or through the app. Continuing to use Tiimo after an update means you agree to the revised policy.
